item.title: Sortieange Mahou Club
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Micro
  • 発売日: 2007-09-28
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ソルティアンジュ魔法倶楽部
  • 英語名: Sortieange Mahou Club

あらすじ

One day, a pillar of light suddenly appears from the sky and it never goes out again. People are surprised to see it at first, but they get used to it after two weeks. The main character is Shoutaro, a high school student. He meets two girls at school.

“Let’s form a magic club together!”

item.title: CooL!! ~Tsuyoki na Otome no Pure Love Story~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Micro
  • 発売日: 2006-09-29
  • スコア: 6.32/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: CooL!! ～強娘純恋歌～
  • 英語名: CooL!! Tsuyoki na Otome no Pure Love Story

别名

  • CooL!! つよきなおとめのピュア・ラブストーリー

あらすじ

The stage is a high school that became coed five years ago. But the power of female students is still strong…. Yohei is in his second year of this school, feeling small at school. One day, he receives a summon from the student council… and his life changes….
